use default

let top = 1_000_000_000
let segment_size = 1 << 20

base_primes(bound: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let composite = LIST()

    for _ in 0::bound do
        composite.add(false)
    od

    let factor mut = 2

    while factor * factor <= bound do
        if !composite[factor] then
            let multiple mut = factor * factor

            while multiple <= bound do
                composite[multiple] = true
                multiple = multiple + factor
            od
        fi

        factor = factor + 1
    od

    (2::bound) |> filter(value => !composite[value]) |> collect_list()
si

primes_below(bound: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let root_bound = cast int(System.Math.sqrt(cast double(bound))) + 1
    let roots = base_primes(root_bound)
    let block = LIST()

    for _ in 0..segment_size do
        block.add(false)
    od

    let low mut = 2

    while low < bound do
        let high = System.Math.min(low + segment_size, bound)

        for index in 0..segment_size do
            block[index] = false
        od

        for root in roots do
            if root * root >= high then break fi

            let start = (low + root - 1) / root * root
            let first mut = System.Math.max(root * root, start)

            while first < high do
                block[first - low] = true
                first = first + root
            od
        od

        for value in low..high do
            if !block[value - low] then
                yield value
            fi
        od

        low = high
    od

signature(value: int) -> long is
    let counts mut = 0L
    let remaining mut = value

    while remaining > 0 do
        counts = counts + (1L << (4 * (remaining % 10)))
        remaining = remaining / 10
    od

    counts

let smallest = LIST[int]()
let triples mut = 0

let two_back mut = 0
let one_back mut = 0
let two_back_signature mut = 0L
let one_back_signature mut = 0L

for prime in primes_below(top) do
    let mark = signature(prime)

    if two_back > 0 /\ one_back_signature == mark /\
       two_back_signature == mark
    then
        triples = triples + 1

        if smallest.count < 25 then
            smallest.add(two_back)
        fi
    fi

    two_back = one_back
    two_back_signature = one_back_signature
    one_back = prime
    one_back_signature = mark
od

write_line("the smallest member of the first 25 Ormiston triples:")

    let cells = smallest[row * 5..row * 5 + 5] |> map(v => "{v,12:N0}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
